title.narrative: Enhancing Climate Adaptive Resilience and Economic Recovery (ECARE)

description.narrative: Pakistan faces intersecting crises of climate-induced disasters, economic instability, and energy insecurity, disproportionately affecting vulnerable populations. The 2022 floods, which impacted over 33 million people and caused nearly USD 30 billion in damages, underscore the urgent need for integrated, resilient solutions.This project addresses these challenges through a transformative, multi-sectoral approach. It is structured around three interlinked outcomes:1. Enhancing anticipatory early warning systems using IoT-based multi-hazard monitoring, real-time data sharing, and culturally responsive communication.2. Supporting inclusive economic empowerment, particularly for women, through targeted livelihood restoration, financial inclusion, and skills development.3. Promoting climate resilience and decentralised renewable energy via climate-smart agriculture, local economic revitalisation, and off-grid energy systems.The project document is the umbrella program, which will serve as the key program for projects and the initiative focusing on enhancing climate resilience through EWS and economic Inclusive recovery, gender empowerment and providing solutions to the energy crisis in Pakistan by transitioning coal with renewable energy options/alternatives. An initial USD 4 million has been secured from the Government of China (CIDCA) for Outcome 1. The ECARE programme will adopt a phased financing model, enabling additional energy and economic empowerment projects to be integrated as funding becomes available. Future resource mobilisation will target bilateral and multilateral donors, the private sector, and international financial institutions.
